04-09-1698 is September 4, 1698.  
Add 132 days:  
September has 30 days → +26 days → September 30.  
Remaining days: 132 − 26 = 106 days.  
October (31) → 106 − 31 = 75 left.  
November (30) → 75 − 30 = 45 left.  
December (31) → 45 − 31 = 14 left.  
January 14, 1699.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1699-01-14
